_comment: Help Scout articles that deliberately have NO published page. This is the decision record, not a cache — it is hand-maintained and committed. scripts/ingest-new.js refuses to publish anything listed here, and scripts/report-drift.js reports edits to them separately so nobody goes hunting for a page that was never meant to exist. To publish one: delete its entry, run `npm run ingest -- --preview .preview --only <slug>` to review, then `npm run ingest -- --write`. Keys are <section>/<slug>, matching data/markdown/ and the baseline.
